scope: Recover unregistered framed, no-branch ranges into byte-exact C++ proposals. Worker B owns isolated proposals and reports only.
verification_method: per-range sha256 of the ELF bytes plus start/end/size agreement against /root/kh2fm-build/layout.tsv, before any source is written
picker: round-24/pick_targets.py - round-23's picker with the ATTEMPTED set harvested automatically from every round-N/claim.json, primary's live claim re-read at run time, and four standing exclusions (frame-pointer `sd s8` idiom; `movz`/`movn` if-conversion refusal; `lq`/`sq` quad copies; three-or-more consecutive same-base stores/loads). 756 candidates; the batch is the first 16, all 76-byte no-branch bodies.
ownership: Worker B writes only sources under analysis/final-mix/recovery-experiments/ and reports under worker-coordination/worker-b/. Active sources, functions.tsv, layout.tsv, stage sync, full builds, manifests, receipts, Ghidra and HANDOFF.md remain primary's.

round24_result.summary: 5 of 16 claimed ranges recovered byte-exact. Two of the five were exact on the first probe from a recipe established in an earlier round.

001c0ce8.mechanism: uVar1 = puVar2[354] & 0x80; asm volatile ("" : "+r"(uVar1)); iVar1 = (0 < uVar1);
001c0ce8.note: register barrier stops GCC rewriting (x&0x80)!=0 into sra+andi

002db808.note: trailing asm stops the final call being tail-called

002ed2b0.mechanism: seven-argument dispatch func_001c23a8(p1,p2,0,1,0,128,p3) then vtable set and global store
002ed2b0.note: argument list read off the register shuffle

0017a6c8.reason: 19 words; the target holds the global page in a callee-saved register across the whole body

001c2c98.reason: 2 words: the last two stores are transposed. v03 (memory barrier) and v04 (interleaved stores) both regress to 7

002007e0.reason: 3 words: GCC folds the two-level indirection into one register. v03 (named temp) re-enabled the tail call, v04 (named temp + register barrier) is worse

00224cf0.reason: not attempted: the body is a jump-table dispatch with case targets outside the claimed range

002956c0.reason: 2 words: the target shifts the callee return in $v0, GCC reuses $t7. v03 regressed to 72/76

003015a8.reason: not attempted: 112-byte frame with a varargs-style call

00307f90.reason: not attempted: 128-byte frame spilling four argument registers, va_list shaped

new_mechanisms: REGISTER BARRIER ON A MASKED BOOLEAN (001c0ce8): asm volatile ("" : "+r"(uVar1)) on the result of an AND stops GCC rewriting (x & 0x80) != 0 into sra+andi. NOTE: the same barrier does NOT rescue the round-19 lhu sign-extension family - retried on 001bb9b0/001bbec0/001bbf00 and all three stayed at 68/64 or worse. The lever is specific to the boolean-and form.

ONE-WORD MISSES ARE USUALLY THE TAIL CALL (6 targets): every 72/76 result in this batch was GCC turning the final call into a sibling tail call, dropping ld ra. A trailing asm volatile ("") fixed all six at once - the same lever recorded in round 8.
round24_result.picker_weakness: The picker tags come from the decompiled pseudocode, not the instruction words. 0017a6c8 was tagged NO-BRANCH and is the worst result in the batch; the machine code plainly branches. Treat the tag as weak evidence.
process_notes: Four of this round's variants regressed against their own predecessors and were recorded as such rather than quietly replaced: 001c2c98 v03/v04, 002007e0 v03/v04, 002956c0 v03.
